name: loki-mode
tagline_zh: 纯属好玩，装了不亏：loki-mode。英文简介见下。
desc_en: Autonomous spec-driven build system with a built-in trust layer. It does not call work done until it is verified (RARV-C closure loop, 8 quality gates, completion council, verified-completion evidence gate). Triggers on "Loki Mode". Takes a spec (PRD, GitHub issue, OpenAPI doc, etc.) to deployed product with minimal human intervention. Provider-agnostic. Requires --dangerously-skip-permissions fla
